project.title: GIFF 2025 Poster
project.maker: Andréa Philippon for the Geneva International Film Festival
project.format: Poster system for GIFF and Geneva Digital Market

why: A clear reference for making a complex festival feel interconnected: colorful transparent blocks form the two event logos, turning system logic and data-like assembly into the poster's primary image.

compositions.title: Logos as a constructed object
compositions.study: Transparent, colorful blocks interlock to form GIFF and GDM, so the mark reads as a built environment rather than a flat lockup.
compositions.reuse: Translate a multi-part event or product family into one modular object whose pieces can recombine across formats.

compositions.title: Accessible data-wall energy
compositions.study: The visual language pairs vivid color with transparent overlaps and dynamic blocks, balancing technological aesthetics with an accessible festival tone.
compositions.reuse: Use a saturated palette with translucent layers when a technical theme needs warmth and collective energy rather than cold interface literalism.

assets.notes: The source describes the blocks as colorful, transparent, dynamic, and interlocking; no external assets are copied into this library.
assets.reuse: Rebuild the grammar with original CSS, SVG, or 3D primitives rather than reusing the source artwork.

assets.notes: The formed logos carry the identity while the modular blocks supply the visual texture.
assets.reuse: Let identity emerge from the construction system when a poster must hold multiple related names.

implementation.format: Poster-led festival identity with a modular 3D/block visual language
implementation.notes: The official GIFF page documents the artist, event context, material language, and the relationship between GIFF and GDM. It is sufficient for an accepted composition study, but not a source for copied artwork or production assets.
